standard.summary: 通过 1/(1-α_t) 加权来去除标准 diffusion loss 中的偏差，让模型对所有 timestep 的学习更加均衡。是 min_snr_gamma 的替代方案。
standard.effect: 在大 timestep（高噪声）端比 min_snr_gamma 更激进地提升权重。适合需要强去噪能力的场景。
standard.whenToUse: min_snr_gamma 效果不够时尝试。学术研究或需要严格去偏时。
standard.avoidWhen: 与 min_snr_gamma 不应同时使用。数据极少时可能不稳定。

standard_en.summary: Removes the bias in the standard diffusion loss by weighting with 1/(1-alpha_t), balancing what the model learns across all timesteps. An alternative to min_snr_gamma.
standard_en.effect: Raises the weight at the large-timestep (high-noise) end more aggressively than min_snr_gamma does. It suits cases that need strong denoising ability.
standard_en.whenToUse: Worth trying when min_snr_gamma is not enough, in academic work, or when strict debiasing is required.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It should not be used together with min_snr_gamma, and can be unstable with very little data.

advanced.principle: 标准 MSE loss 的期望值 E[||ε - ε_θ||²] 在不同 timestep 下是有偏的。debiased estimation 通过乘以 1/(1-α_t) 来修正这个偏差，使得各 timestep 的 loss 期望值更一致。数学上等价于 score matching 的去偏估计。
advanced.expectedImpact: 对高噪声 timestep 的学习改善更激进。整体效果与 min_snr_gamma 类似但分布不同。
advanced.tradeoffs: 在大 timestep 端权重可能过大导致不稳定，需要观察 loss 曲线。

advanced_en.principle: Standard MSE loss's expectation E[||ε - ε_θ||²] is biased across timesteps. Debiased estimation corrects this by multiplying by 1/(1-α_t), making the expected loss more consistent across timesteps. Mathematically equivalent to the debiased estimator in score matching.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: More aggressive improvement on high-noise timesteps. Overall similar to min_snr_gamma but with a different distribution.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Weights at the large-timestep end can be too large and destabilize; watch the loss curve.
